queue_statements.query:
SELECT status, id, token, context, timeout_ms, context_bytes,
                CASE WHEN $6::boolean AND status = $7
                    THEN mesh_jobs.now_ms()::text END AS observed_at_ms, ordinality::text
         FROM mesh_jobs.claim_batch_bounded_v1($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4::bigint, $5::integer, $8)
         WITH ORDINALITY

WITH clock AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS now_ms)
         SELECT coalesce((
             SELECT greatest(j.scheduled_at_ms - (SELECT now_ms FROM clock), $5)::text
             FROM mesh_jobs.queues q JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j
                 ON j.namespace = q.namespace AND j.queue = q.name
             WHERE q.namespace = $1 AND q.name = $2 AND q.state = $6 AND q.concurrency > $7
                 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.queues paused
                     WHERE paused.namespace = $1 AND paused.name = $8 AND paused.state = $9)
                 AND j.state IN ($10, $11, $12)
                 AND j.scheduled_at_ms > $4::bigint AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                             WHERE w.worker = j.worker AND w.version = j.version)
             ORDER BY j.scheduled_at_ms LIMIT $13
         ), $14)

WITH functions AS (
                 SELECT to_regprocedure($5) AS renew,
                        to_regprocedure($6) AS settle,
                        to_regprocedure($7) AS batch,
                        to_regprocedure($8) AS single_claim,
                        to_regprocedure($9) AS batch_set,
                        to_regprocedure($10) AS batch_bounded,
                        to_regprocedure($11) AS complete_batch
             ) SELECT CASE
                 WHEN version <> $12 OR to_regclass($13) IS NULL
                     OR renew IS NULL OR settle IS NULL THEN $14
                 WHEN NOT (has_function_privilege(renew, $15)
                     AND has_function_privilege(settle, $16)) THEN $17
                 WHEN $1::boolean AND batch IS NULL THEN $18
                 WHEN $1::boolean AND NOT has_function_privilege(batch, $19) THEN $20
                 WHEN $2::boolean AND single_claim IS NULL THEN $21
                 WHEN $2::boolean AND NOT has_function_privilege(single_claim, $22) THEN $23
                 WHEN $3::boolean AND batch_set IS NULL THEN $24
                 WHEN $3::boolean AND NOT has_function_privilege(batch_set, $25) THEN $26
                 WHEN $4::boolean AND (batch_bounded IS NULL OR complete_batch IS NULL) THEN $27
                 WHEN $4::boolean AND NOT (has_function_privilege(batch_bounded, $28)
                     AND has_function_privilege(complete_batch, $29)) THEN $30
                 ELSE $31
             END FROM mesh_jobs.schema_version CROSS JOIN functions WHERE singleton
